name: Sullivan's Blueberry Farm
description: Sullivan's Blueberry Farm grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 642 Walkertown Road, TN. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
